# Question 1: Estimateurs Non Paramétriques avec récursivité de la dérivée d'une fonction de régression non paramétrique

```{r}
N <- 1000 # sample size
alpha <- 10 # parameter for h_n
seq_h <- sapply(seq(1, N, 1), e_n) # bandwidth
e_n <- function(x) {
  return((1/x^alpha))
}
Y <- rnorm(N, 0, 1) # proxy data
X <- seq(1, 1000, 1) # time data

# estimator n°1 toolbox

h_N <- function(x) {
  return((1/N)*(sum((Y/h)*K_gaussian((x-X)/h))))
}

g_N <- function(x) {
  return((1/N)*(sum((1/h)*K_gaussian((x-X)/h))))
}

h_N_prime <- function(x) {
  return()
}

g_N_prime <- function(x) {
  return()
}

es_n1 <- function(x) {
  return((h_N_prime(x)/g_N(x)) - (h_N(x)*g_N_prime(x))/(g_N(x))^2)
}

# estimator n°2

g <- function(x) {
  return(print("case g is known"))
}

g_prime <- function(x){
  return(print"case g is known")
}

es_n2 <- function(x) {
  return((h_N_prime(x)/g(x)) - (h_N(x)*g_prime(x))/(g(x))^2)
}

# estimator n°3

es_n3 <- function(x) {
  return((1/N)*(sum(Y/g(x)*h_N^2)*K_prime((x-X_N)/h_N)))
}

# kernels
K_gaussian <- function(x) {
  return(pnorm(x))
}

K_epach <- function(x) {
  return(ifelse(abs(x) <= 1, (3/4)*(1-x^2), 0))
}

K_quadra <- function(x) {
  return(ifelse(abs(x) <= 1,
                (15/16)*(1-x^2)^2), 0)
}
```
